Calendar uncertainty does not justify those counts.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00697","case1_error":"Treats each smaller antacid as weighing three grams instead of the stated one gram.","case2_error":"Subtracts the restaurant allocation twice, miscalculates that subtraction, introduces unsupported 56 bags, and incorrectly evaluates 408 ÷ 56.","reason":"The first substitutes the wrong per-item weight; the second double-counts an allocation and adds independent numerical and unsupported-value errors.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00698","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written calorie sum as 2,175 instead of 1,975.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written six-day water sum as 49 instead of 51.","reason":"Both incorrectly evaluate a correctly specified sum, then correctly subtract the erroneous subtotal from the overall limit or total.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00699","case1_error":"Answers with 72 ounces of prepared beverage rather than applying the ratio to obtain nine ounces of tea ingredient.","case2_error":"Evaluates 9 + 9 + 9 + 8 + 8 + 8 as 49 instead of 51.","reason":"The first answers the wrong quantity and fails to apply the ingredient ratio; the second numerically miscalculates a correct expression.","judgment":"different"}]}
